one_line: Customer support platform with a very broad set of REST APIs across Support, Help Center, Talk, Chat, Sell, Messaging, and apps.
auth_notes: API token (email + token via basic auth) or OAuth2 for apps; per-product APIs (Support, Help Center, Talk, Chat, Sell, Sunshine Conversations, ZIS). Public Postman workspace available.
self_serve_notes: Free trial then paid plans; API token is self-serve from the admin UI once you have a Zendesk subdomain/account.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Support, Help Center, Talk, Chat, Sell, Messaging, Custom Objects, Apps, and Integration Services (ZIS) APIs
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks API plus ZIS inbound webhooks for triggering external integrations

existing_mcp.note: No official Zendesk MCP server found; several community servers exist on GitHub/MCP registry

evidence.note: Fetched API reference home confirmed API breadth across products and Postman workspace; auth details from knowledge

agent_notes: API breadth and products confirmed from fetched text. Needs a trial/paid account plus subdomain; no official MCP.
